checklist.title: Synthetic contract example
checklist.description: Own fixture, not official rubric and not a model evaluation.

criteria.title: Operator introduction
criteria.instruction: Yes if the first operator response greets and introduces the operator. Bot greetings do not count.

criteria.title: Clear response
criteria.instruction: Choose the configured clarity level. Assess clarity, not external factual correctness of opening hours.

criteria.title: Identity verification
criteria.instruction: Yes if required identity verification precedes a protected account action.
criteria.na_rule: The customer asks only a general public question; no protected account action is requested.

criteria.title: Explicit insult
criteria.instruction: Yes if the operator explicitly insults the customer. This is a separate flag, not a numeric penalty.
